slides.title: Kicking at the bar.
slides.body: Legs fly up, miss, swing down, swing wider. Every rep starts from a bigger mess than the last.

slides.title: Push the bar down.
slides.body: Straight arms, press the bar toward your hips. Your lats tip you into the hollow. Your abs finish it.

slides.title: Arch, hollow, arch.
slides.body: Chest through the arms, then snap to hollow. Small and tight. The swing is a tool, not a ride.

slides.title: Feet back on the way down.
slides.body: Drop your feet behind the bar, not straight down. That arch loads your next rep.

slides.title: Knee raises first.
slides.body: Tight kipping knee raises beat sloppy toes-to-bar. Build the rhythm first, then add the range.
